capabilities.notes: Production signup-to-CRM operator canary is accepted with idempotent replay and zero external sends; broader launch-spine role consumption still requires exact protected inputs.

Current production read-only route proof passed for login, activate, forgot-password, and reset-password. Transactional email is deployed/configured and staging-delivered; production final admin/access send and setup/reset link browser smoke were not rerun in the CRM import slice.
Protected production browser acceptance passed in W13-103. W13-104 did not consume final handoff links again.

CRM surfaces and domain services are deployed; corrected dry-run, guarded apply, production migration 2204, real CRM import apply, idempotency replay, reconciliation, and production signup proof are recorded.

CRM production apply completed after fresh protected PG18 backup proof and exact operator authorization: 1,555 contacts inserted, 4 existing contacts skipped, 2,505 import rows recorded, idempotency replay wrote nothing, and zero sends/provider mutations were performed.

Communications UI/outbox foundation is deployed. Standalone One Time transactional email config is deployed to staging and production; staging controlled lifecycle email was provider-delivered. Campaign seed approval packet is ready for operator approval, with zero seed/broad sends performed.
Owner/admin routes are deployed and role access was accepted through W13-103 protected handoff.
Parent activation/login and controls passed W13-103 protected production acceptance.
Student activation/login, dashboard access, and negative CRM/parent checks passed W13-103 protected production acceptance.

Classes/classroom core is integrated; live Zoom canary is blocked by missing protected canary manifest and provider configuration. Provider canary readiness preflight is recorded and blocked before external mutation until protected inputs are present.

Content workspace/Vimeo seams are implemented; protected Vimeo/content canary is blocked by missing manifest and provider configuration. Provider canary readiness preflight is recorded and blocked before external mutation until protected inputs are present.

Helper runtime remains disabled without OPENAI_API_KEY and ONE_TIME_HELPER_RUNTIME_ENABLED. Provider canary readiness preflight is recorded and blocked before external mutation until protected inputs are present.
Gamification migration 2203 remains applied; production latest migration is now 2204_w12_100_real_source_crm_apply after the CRM import slice.

Protected One Time Resend inputs are present, Railway variables are configured on staging and production, staging controlled transactional email was provider-delivered, and production is deployed/smoked. Production final admin/access send was not rerun in the CRM import slice and remains a deliberate separate action.
